steps.step: KR1 T-fixed points of the bcc Brillouin torus are exactly Gamma, H, P, -P; T has no invariant vector (irreducible on R^3) -> every T-covariant d vanishes there: >= 4 band touchings, minimal doubling impossible with full mark rotation symmetry
KR2 random T-covariant fields (range <= 2) vanish at Gamma, H, P, -P; random C3-covariant fields do not vanish at H, -P
steps.detail: max |d_T| at fixed points 7.8e-16; min |d_C3| at H,-P 0.21

steps.step: KR3 subgroups of T: 1, three C2, four C3, V4, T; nonzero invariant vector iff 1, C2, C3 -> the largest subgroup compatible with minimal doubling is C3 (the stabiliser of one mark): minimal doubling forces T-breaking, a single mark only under maximal residual symmetry

KR4 nearest-neighbour C3 class (all eight bcc steps): unit isotropic cone at Gamma, mirror at P with isotropic equal-speed cone and opposite chirality is the TWO-parameter family (theta, gamma): beta has eigenvalues e^{+-i theta} off-axis, the axis-hop amplitudes are (g2, g1) = (gamma, -gamma), alpha = I - gamma J; the branch g1 + g2 = 1/2 has mirror chirality +1
steps.detail: samples (theta, gamma) = (0.9,0), (2.0,0.13), (4.1,-0.2): chirality [-1, -1, -1]; g1+g2 = 1/2 branch (d(P)=0, orthogonal, chirality) = (True, True, 1)

steps.step: KR4b the gamma direction is a genuine family of minimally doubled kinetics (theta = 120 deg, gamma = +-0.05, +-0.1: two nodes, chirality sum 0); it is removed only by the condition (viii) 'no hop along the selected mark axis' (g1 = g2 = 0), which is what h_W does

KR5 node census on the circle: theta = 0 has eight nodes; exactly two nodes (Gamma +1, P -1) on one contiguous arc containing +-120 degrees; Theta_1's h_W (d_i = sin p_i + cos p_{i+1} - 1) is theta = 120 degrees

steps.step: KR3b minimal doubling is open: three random C3-breaking nearest-neighbour perturbations (size 0.04) of h_W keep exactly two nodes with chirality sum 0 while violating C3 -> minimal doubling forces only T-breaking, not C3
KR5b arc boundary by bisection (finer grid): minimal doubling for theta in (theta_c, 360 - theta_c)

KR6 IR versus fundamental along the arc (theta = 60, 120, 180): identical Gamma cone (|E - |k|| = O(k^2), members differ by <= 1e-6 at |k| = 1e-3), but the spin-resolved return probability near the mirror differs at O(1): conditions (ii)-(vi), (viii) are fundamental, not IR
